caption: The drawing depicts a single round, cylindrical object positioned centrally on an off-white or beige background. The object is primarily yellowish-brown in color, with darker brown highlights and shading. It features a decorative, repeating geometric pattern consisting of diamond shapes and small dots on the side surface, with a border separating the main pattern from the base, which has vertical ridges. The top of the object is wider, with a central depression or hole that is shaded to suggest depth, and the area around the depression is darker brown. There is a faint inscription of the name "JANET RIZA" in light gray below and to the right of the object. In the lower left corner, there is a small, faint ruler or scale mark. The composition is minimal, with the background left largely empty except for the described elements.
title: Inkwell
